text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Incident alert — serving cluster gpu-prod reported repeated CUDA illegal memory access (misaligned address) on worker-7g. Error rate spike and several containers restarted automatically.

emily: paging oncall-sre, I'm answering. seeing 503s for /v1/generate in multiple regions. metric: gpu-exceptions increased x25 in last 3m.

mike: on it. any corrs with recent rollout? I see a dedicated pool autoscaling event ~2m ago.

luis: yes, we rolled model rdx-embed-v2.3 to pool-7 earlier. CPU/ram OK but GPU faults rising.

jordan: logs from pod gpu-worker-7g:
```
E CudaError: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS at kernel.cu:170
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
*** Fatal ***/dev/shm/kvcache mmap failed
```

ashley: that looks like misaligned memory access inside fused-attention kernel. might be kernel regression or race on KV cache.

mike: action plan proposals:
- cordon node gpu-worker-7g
- evict pods and failover to pool-6
- rollback rdx-embed-v2.3 to rdx-embed-v2.2 (if model variant is implicated)
- capture full kernel oops and gdb backtrace from container

emily: agree. cordon + migrate first. reduce customer impact. initiating now.

deploy-bot: Deploy evict pods on node gpu-worker-7g: kubectl drain gpu-worker-7g --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data

mike: draining... seeing pods come up on pool-6, traffic shifting via smart-routing. Console shows increased latency on handover but success so far.

luis: attaching kernel ring buffer snippet from node:
```
[  345.123456] NVRM: Xid (0001:86) at 0x3f0ef10e0 ...
[  345.123457] NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[  345.123460] kernel: BUG: misaligned address 0x7ffd9ab2fde0
```

jordan: hmm 'GPU has fallen off the bus' usually from bad kernel interactions. Let's keep gpu-driver pinned, check if recent kernel upgrade happened.

ashley: drivers unchanged last 24h. Only change was the model rollout with updated fused kernels in the runtime (commit 9a7b2c). That could be causing misaligned accesses under certain sequence lengths.

emily: current customer impact: ~12% of requests to endpoint /v1/generate are 502/503 for some tenants, mostly large sequence lengths >4k.

mike: mitigation: revert runtime build to previous commit on the Dedicated pool and roll back the model variant to v2.2 on the hot nodes. I'll open a canary rollback.

luis: collecting core dumps from container. please do not delete the pods yet. attaching steps for gdb:
```
kubectl cp gpu-worker-7g:/var/crash/core.kernel /tmp/core.7g
gdb --batch -ex "thread apply all bt" -ex quit /opt/runtime/bin/serving runtime.bin core.7g > /tmp/backtrace.txt
```

jordan: FYI I'm toggling KV cache to per-request mode to avoid shared KV alignment issues: set REDWOOD_KV_MODE=per-request on the pool config.

emily: that's live. traffic now hitting fallback model variant on pool-6 for sessions > 4k tokens. latency up ~80ms but error rate dropping.

deploy-bot: Rollback canary started: runtime-image:9a7b2c -> runtime-image:8f3d11 on nodes pool-7 (10% first)

mike: can we hotpatch node GPU driver? riskier. prefer application rollback first.

ashley: agreed. if backtrace shows kernel-level pointer arithmetic bug in fused kernel we may need a runtime patch.

luis: backtrace extract:
```
#0  0x00007f2b7a3b1d4 in fused_attention_forward (args=0x7ffd...) at fused.cu:412
#1  0x00007f2b7a3b2ab in compute_attention (..)
#2  0x000055c3d4f2a1 in serving::forward()
```

jordan: looks like fused.cu index calc overflow for certain seq_len alignment -> misaligned memory load.

mike: patch idea: add alignment checks in runtime and fallback to reference kernel when misalignment detected. short-term: disable fused kernels via env FUSED_ATTENTION=0 on pool config.

emily: switching off fused kernels on pool-7 and pool-6 for affected classes. applying now.

deploy-bot: Set env FUSED_ATTENTION=0 for pool labels: large-seqlen=true

ashley: after disabling fused kernel, observed immediate drop in CUDA illegal access occurrences. error rate almost back to baseline.

emily: customers: SLO alert triggered for 3 enterprise tenants. Emily -> reaching out to account reps with incident notice and mitigation steps, will include rollback timeline.

mike: creating incident ticket: INC-2026-7423, severity P1 -> include backtraces, kernel logs, rollout timeline, and mitigation steps. tagging infra and runtime teams.

luis: saving core dumps and kernel logs to /mnt/incident/1816324829/ for postmortem. recommend a hotfix to fused kernel index bounds checks.

jordan: follow-up actions:
- PR to add alignment guards + unit tests for uncommon sequence lengths
- runtime integration test covering live KV cache interaction
- upgrade canary process to include GPU-exception smoke tests
- schedule on-call review tomorrow 10:00 UTC

emily: thanks team. keeping channel open until rollbacks finish and error rates stable. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident resolved for now — error rate returned to baseline, node gpu-worker-7g remains cordoned. Please file postmortem within 72h.
